items.title: 8.14 Darja hararat ki tabdeeli ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.14, printed pages 181-182.

blocks.text: Le Chatelier ke principle se andaza lagaya ja sakta hai ke temperature badalne par reaction kis taraf jayegi. Temperature wahid (akela) factor hai jo equilibrium constant (Kc) ki value bhi badalta hai.
Exothermic reaction (jo heat deti hai) mein temperature barhana (heat dena) reverse reaction ke haq mein hai, aur temperature kam karna (heat nikalna) forward reaction ke haq mein.
SO₂ se SO₃ banne ki equation yeh hai:
Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq temperature barhane se reaction right se left shift hoti hai.

Is se SO₃ ki concentration kam aur SO₂ aur O₂ ki concentrations zyada ho jati hain. Is liye equilibrium constant ki value kam ho jati hai aur equilibrium left shift hota hai. Doosri taraf, temperature kam karne se forward reaction aur product (SO₃) banne ko faida hota hai, yani SO₃ kam temperature par zyada banti hai: temperature kam karne se reaction left se right shift hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai 'an increase in temperature will shift the reaction from left to right' aur phir SO₃ aur Kc barhne ki baat karti hai. Yahan 'increase' ki jagah 'decrease' hona chahiye: temperature kam karne se reaction right shift hoti hai, SO₃ aur Kc barhte hain. Kitab ki apni Kc values (298 K par 1 × 10²⁶, 1000 K par 2.8 × 10²) isi ki tasdeeq karti hain.
Is tabdeeli se SO₃ ki concentration barhti hai aur SO₂ aur O₂ ki kam hoti hai, is liye equilibrium constant ki value barhti hai.

Equilibrium right shift hota hai. Iske ulat, temperature barhana reverse reaction aur reactants banne ke haq mein hai, is liye zyada temperature par SO₃ kam banti hai. Is reaction ka Kc 1000 K par 2.8 × 10² hai, jabke 298 K par 1 × 10²⁶.
Endothermic reaction (jo heat leti hai) mein temperature barhana forward reaction ke haq mein hai, aur temperature kam karna reverse reaction ke haq mein.
N₂O₄ se NO₂ banne ki equation yeh hai:
Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq temperature barhane se reaction left se right shift hoti hai.
Is se N₂O₄ ki concentration kam aur NO₂ ki zyada hoti hai, is liye Kc barhta hai. Equilibrium right shift hota hai; temperature barhana forward reaction aur product banne ke haq mein hai.
Doosri taraf, temperature kam karne se reaction right se left shift hoti hai; yeh reverse reaction aur reactant banne ke haq mein hai.
Is reaction ka Kc 273 K par 7.7 × 10⁻⁵ aur 373 K par 0.4 hai.

blocks.prompt: 2H₂O(g) ⇌ 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) ki forward reaction endothermic hai. Kaun si tabdeeli pani (H₂O) ki equilibrium miqdar kam karegi: oxygen dalna, catalyst dalna, volume kam karna, ya constant pressure par temperature barhana?
blocks.explanation: Temperature barhana: endothermic forward reaction ko faida hota hai aur pani zyada toot-ta hai. Oxygen dalne se equilibrium wapas pani ki taraf jata hai; volume kam karne se kam gas moles wali taraf (pani) ko faida hota hai; catalyst sirf raftar badalta hai.

items: Exothermic (SO₃ banna, −198 kJ): garam karne se left shift aur Kc kam.
Endothermic (N₂O₄ ka tootna, +57.2 kJ): garam karne se right shift aur Kc zyada.
